errors.text: The material family is misidentified: the target is as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA with FCC and B2 phases, not a refractory BCC HEA such as NbMoTaW.
No cited evidence establishes the necessary prior observation of temperature-dependent L12 chemical ordering in FCC domains, much less ordering approaching Ni3Al stoichiometry.

The proposed precipitate formation/coarsening/dissolution mechanism omits the target coupling between enhanced L12 ordering, elevated antiphase-boundary energy, planar slip, and jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary stress concentrations.

The evidence does not support a ductile-brittle-ductile aging transition in the proposed refractory alloys; several citations concern unrelated magnetism, baseline brittleness, or coherent precipitates that improve rather than suppress ductility.

The falsification experiment varies aging time at 500 degrees C rather than mapping the critical temperature window and therefore cannot test the target minimum near 600 degrees C and recovery near 750 degrees C.
